# Glossary (667 names)

## site index: packages

- **--allow-git**: The npm flag that lets npm fetch a package from a git repository. npm 12 and newer refuse a git package unless told; an older npm takes the flag and changes nothing. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#allow-git))_
- **JAX**: The Python library thrml is written in: thrml, Extropic's block Gibbs sampler, is a library in JAX. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#jax))_
- **KANERVA**: A Rust library that stores binary patterns in Kanerva's sparse distributed memory and reads them back from noisy read-addresses. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#kanerva-package))_
- **MCP**: settle-mcp, a Model Context Protocol server that lets an assistant read the SETTLE and KANERVA docs, set them up and run programs. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#settle-mcp))_
- **SETTLE**: A small programming language for settling machines: you declare things, leans and pulls, then let them settle and count. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#settle))_
- **SETTLE TEXT**: settle-text, the React component library: text, images and vectors rendered as a live settle of lights, with no theory needed. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#settle-text))_
- **settle-hear**: SETTLE's hearing library: it makes sound from a settle's own numbers. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#settle-hear))_
- **settle-see**: SETTLE's seeing library: every picture it draws is a grid of p-bits settling out of noise into a word or a shape. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#settle-see))_
- **THE AMBIENT SHIMMER**: settle-text's schedule of small effects: every piece of text deals its own shimmers, a glint, a few lights blinking or a soft breath, and about one in ten is a full re-settle. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#ambient-shimmer))_
- **the MCP SDK**: The Model Context Protocol SDK: one of settle-mcp's two dependencies, the other being zod. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#mcp-sdk))_
- **THERMOSIM**: The Python player the SETTLE campaign began with: a simulated thermodynamic chip settling into video frames. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#thermosim))_

## site word

- **22.3%**: A settle begun from noise often ends in a mirror or in a fake valley: 22.3% fake for 5 random patterns. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/pages/SdmMemory.jsx)_
- **99.2%**: The match has a limit: at softness 1 the two reads agree on 99.2% of bits and both recall 0%, because the matching inverse temperature is too low to pick out one pattern. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/pages/SdmMemory.jsx)_
- **a light device**: a weak device (low power), never a dim one (TRANSLATEJUDGE, 2026-10-04) _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **access circle**: the hard locations an address activates (Kanerva 1988) _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **activation probability**: Kanerva's probability of activation p _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **activation radius**: Kanerva's activation radius _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **address**: what an SDM reads with _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **address matrix**: Kanerva's A _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **address register**: Kanerva's register _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **address-noise**: the fraction of address bits flipped _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **ADJUST**: a dock tooltip word, one word in the button's neon (lane CORNERSETTLE, 2026-10-04) _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **ask**: counting how often a thing was yes _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **attention**: the transformer's mechanism _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **backprop**: backpropagation _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **BAR**: a dock tooltip word, one word in the button's neon (lane CORNERSETTLE, 2026-10-04) _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **basin**: basin of attraction, the share of the landscape that drains into a valley _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **bells**: the sound in the hero setups (TRANSLATEJUDGE, 2026-10-04) _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **best-match**: Kanerva's best-match problem _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **binary spatter code**: Kanerva _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **binding**: binding two hypervectors (XOR) _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **bit-counters**: the up-down counters of a hard location _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **bundling**: adding hypervectors by majority _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **capacity**: a memory's capacity _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **CLICK TO START**: the hero tag while the browser holds the sound (lane CTPTAB, 2026-10-04: was CLICK TO PLAY) _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **cloud**: a cloud of samples or walkers, never クラウド (TRANSLATEJUDGE, 2026-10-04) _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **content-addressable**: as in 内容参照メモリ (CAM) _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **contents matrix**: Kanerva's C _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **critical distance**: Kanerva's critical distance _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **data-word**: the word stored and read back _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **diffusion**: as in a diffusion model _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **distributed**: The memory is called sparse because its locations are a tiny sample of all possible addresses, and distributed because every word is spread over many hard locations and every hard location holds a blend of many words. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/pages/Kanerva.jsx)_
- **dollar**: Push dollar through the map and peso comes out. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/pages/kanerva/Analogies.jsx)_
- **ELBO**: the evidence lower bound _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **EXPAND**: a dock tooltip word, one word in the button's neon (lane CORNERSETTLE, 2026-10-04) _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **fluctuation-dissipation**: as in the fluctuation-dissipation theorem _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **free energy principle**: Friston _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **fuck off.**: THE FINAL BOSS on the WHAT page swears (lane WHATCHAIN) _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **Gibbs**: as in Gibbs sampling, ギブズサンプリング _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **gradient descent**: hero word (lane HEROWORDS, 2026-10-02) _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **hard locations**: Kanerva's memory stores long patterns of bits in a few thousand hard locations, each at a random address in the space of all patterns. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/pages/What.jsx)_
- **hard-locations**: the hero word, hyphenated as the site writes it _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_

- **hero**: the big live picture at the top of the home page _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **hold**: pinning a thing to what was seen _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **holographic reduced representation**: Plate _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **huh?**: a chain's word _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **Ising**: as in the Ising model, イジング模型 _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **ISTED?**: the hero word after Ising, a rider's name _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **iterated reads**: reading again at the last answer _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **Kanerva**: Pentti Kanerva, ペンティ・カネルヴァ _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **KEY**: the colour key in a page's corner _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **kT**: a symbol, never translated _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **lane**: a campaign work lane (TRANSLATEJUDGE, 2026-10-04) _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **Langevin**: as in Langevin dynamics _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **lean**: how much a thing leans toward yes _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **light**: a p-bit drawn as a dot of light _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **LOAD**: the header's load chip _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **mirror image**: The pulls record only which pixels agree with which, so the mirror image of a stored pattern, with every pixel reversed, is a valley as well: E(-s) = E(s). _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/pages/SdmMemory.jsx)_
- **mixture of experts**: MoE _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **no way.**: the boss's word and its first answer _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **noisy address**: The address A is also called a memory cue.” On this site the word is address, and a damaged one is a noisy address. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/pages/kanerva/Analogies.jsx)_
- **p-bit**: a probabilistic bit _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **parallel tempering**: replica exchange _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **peso**: Push dollar through the map and peso comes out. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/pages/kanerva/Analogies.jsx)_
- **PICTURE**: a dock tooltip word, one word in the button's neon (lane CORNERSETTLE, 2026-10-04) _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **PIN**: a dock tooltip word, one word in the button's neon (lane CORNERSETTLE, 2026-10-04) _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **probabilistic computer**: a machine of p-bits _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_

- **read-address**: Kanerva's retrieval address _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **read-threshold**: a summed bit-counter above 0 reads 1 _(SETTLE/settle-site/i18n/GLOSSARY.md)_
- **refusal rule**: They show where the memory holds, where it melts, and what a key or a refusal rule does to a read. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/pages/SdmExplore.jsx)_

- **sparse**: The memory is called sparse because its locations are a tiny sample of all possible addresses, and distributed because every word is spread over many hard locations and every hard location holds a blend of many words. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/pages/Kanerva.jsx)_

## site index: the site

- **40 Hz light**: An opt-in flicker of the picture at 40 Hz, behind a warning. The 432 Hz flute is a separate sound choice, the 40 Hz AND 432 Hz FLUTE MODE, also called the McKusker mode; the light and the flute mode keep two names. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#forty-hz-light))_
- **ASK**: One page where a member asks what SETTLE and KANERVA are, answered by a language model reading the site's own docs. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-ask))_
- **ATARI LIGHT ORGAN**: Eight diamonds, one per band from bass to treble, each swelling with its band. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#atari-light-organ))_
- **BINAURAL**: The sound mode that plays only the binaural tracks, each for about three minutes, in a random order. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#binaural-mode))_
- **BOLTZLEARN**: The experiment whose question was: Can a settled machine learn a small classification task, against a plain baseline? _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-boltzlearn))_
- **burst**: A short settle-see animation that fires when the footer rises on a page change. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#burst))_
- **CONTACT**: How to reach us: an address to copy, the X handle, the repository note and one line in the site's voice. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-contact))_
- **CREDITS**: Who and what SETTLE rests on, Pentti Kanerva first, every citation checked against its link. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-credits))_
- **DEFAULT MODE**: The hero's sound on load, one mix for everyone: the settle's own static loudest, then the binaural pair, then the flute. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#default-mode))_
- **DJ MODE**: The sound mode in which THE DJ plays its sets one after another, and nothing else. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#dj-mode))_
- **DOOMWORLD**: The experiment that turned the SURPRISE game into a textured, neon, multi-room world. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-doomworld))_
- **film**: A sequence of frames a grid settles through: the Muybridge horse, Tears of Steel, or a film computed in code. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#film))_
- **FILMSHARP**: The experiment whose question was: Can leans fitted to the grid itself hold the picture where TAP collapses, does a Rao-Blackwellised read recover the last 1 dB, and does another update rule mix faster? _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-filmsharp))_
- **FULL**: Our SDM language model built from sparse distributed memories in every part: each layer writes and reads a run-time SDM, then reads a few rows of a trained SDM table where a transformer has its MLP. No attention and no MLP. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#full-sdm))_
- **glossary**: The site's dictionary: every word on this site, what we mean by it, where it is used, and where it came from. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#glossary))_
- **GRADSETTLE**: The experiment whose question was: Is gradient descent Settling, and what does the cloud of a hot fit give that one fitted model does not? _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-gradsettle))_
- **GRIDPLAYER**: The experiment whose question was: Does SETTLE reproduce the Python horse-player numbers, and how fast in Rust? _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-gridplayer))_
- **HEADCLIMB**: A research programme run beside the SETTLE campaign: beat the champion expert-prefetch head on its ruler. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-headclimb))_
- **HEAR**: settle-hear on the site: a mixing desk on one live settle, the demo setups, and what each sound means. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-hear))_
- **hero**: The big live picture at the top of the home page: p-bits settling into words, shapes and films about thermodynamic computing. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#hero))_
- **HIT, SPLIT, MISS**: The three verdicts on a prediction an experiment wrote before it measured: right, partly right, wrong. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#verdict))_
- **HOME**: The home page: the hero, GETTING STARTED, the statement families and the campaign summary. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-home))_
- **ISTED**: The hero word after Ising, a rider's name: the hero's one joke. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#isted))_
- **ITUNES BLOOM**: Three soft blooms, low, middle and high, orbiting and swelling with their part of the sound. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#itunes-bloom))_
- **JEV**: In this project, a small head that predicts which experts a large model will route to next, trained on that model's own routing traces. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#jev))_
- **KEY**: The colour key in a page's corner, listing only the neons that page uses. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#key-legend))_
- **light**: A p-bit drawn as a dot of light: lit for yes, dim for no. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#light))_
- **LIKED SETS**: Every set of THE DJ you rated 4 or 5 on the home page while signed in, kept with your account. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-liked))_
- **llms.txt**: A plain-text index of a site for AI agents: a title, a summary, and lists of links to Markdown copies of its documents (the llmstxt.org proposal). _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#llms-txt))_
- **LOAD**: The header's load instrument: a small gauge of how much of the main thread the settles take, with a panel of the numbers; PAUSE ALL stops every live drawing, and it then reads HELD. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#load-chip))_
- **MEDIA PLAYER BARS**: Thin bars standing on a floor, their reflection fading below it. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#media-player-bars))_
- **MEDITATE MODE**: The default sound mode and its resting state: about three turns in four are binaural tracks, and THE DJ plays every fourth turn. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#meditate-mode))_
- **MEMBERS**: Your account, signed in through Clerk: sign up with an emailed code, log in, the little guys and runs you saved from the studio, the ASK chat and your chat balance. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-members))_
- **MIDI**: A file format for notes: which pitch starts and stops when, on which channel, at what velocity, with a tempo and a meter. General MIDI fixes channel 10 as the drums and names each drum by a note number. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#midi))_
- **MILKDROP FIELD**: The last picture zoomed and turned, the wave drawn on top as a ring: the bass zooms, the treble turns. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#milkdrop-field))_
- **MUTE ALL**: The header button that silences every sound on the site; no other control can unmute it. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#mute-all))_
- **NEOCORTEX-FEEDBACK**: A demo page of twelve live settles: the six layers of the neocortex, the loops inside a column and the feedback between areas, the Purkinje cells of the cerebellum, and Kanerva's reading of the cerebellum as a sparse distributed memory. Each panel prints its program and its recorded outputs, and says what is faithful and what is a cartoon. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-neocortex-feedback))_
- **nonogram**: A picture puzzle whose rows and columns give run lengths; as leans and pulls, the hidden picture appears as it settles. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#nonogram))_
- **NUMBERS**: Springs that solve A x = b live: the cloud's centre finds the answer, its spread gives the inverse. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-numbers))_
- **OAKENFOLD**: Our name (yes, after Paul Oakenfold, the DJ), from our research notes, for a generator built of sparse distributed memories: it enfolds a fact into the Complicate, the sum of every write, unfolds it out to the Explicate, the answer, and fold-back writes the verdict in again. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#oakenfold))_
- **packages**: The five package pages, SETTLE, KANERVA, MCP, SETTLE TEXT and SETTLE SEE: the main destinations, each in its own neon, first in every menu. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#packages))_
- **PARTIAL**: Our SDM language model with one ordinary part: each layer writes and reads a run-time SDM, then runs a regular MLP. No attention. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#partial-sdm))_
- **PERFLADDER**: The experiment that profiled the site's live settles and made the engine faster: five quality levels, one picked at page load and kept for the visit, and the halt rule. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-perfladder))_
- **PUZZLES**: Live annealing of sudoku, graph colouring, max-cut and factoring, then the recorded success rates. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-puzzles))_
- **RATE THE DJ**: Five star glyphs among the hero's own text lines: the middle left of the full hero, the top left of its bar. A click rates the set THE DJ is playing. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#rate-the-dj))_
- **RELAX**: The cool-down class: Richard and DHH do aerobics in settles while it teaches how a machine settles. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-relax))_
- **RESULTS**: Every experiment's scoreboard, headline numbers and tables; one experiment's full report; the campaign ledger. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-results))_
- **run-time SDM**: A Kanerva memory written and read while a model reads its text: each token writes its value into a few slots its key picks and reads back what earlier tokens wrote where its query looks, each head fading its writes at its own rate. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#run-time-sdm))_
- **SDM**: A guide to our two SDM language models, FULL and PARTIAL: what each stores, how it writes and reads, how it picks the next word, how the two differ, and why FULL is the one we take forward. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-sdm))_
- **SDM EXPLORE**: An SDM drawn as a state diagram you operate, how SDMCHAT works, and six SETTLE x KANERVA experiments. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-sdmexplore))_
- **SDM-LOOKBACK**: How far back FULL and PARTIAL reach: no window of past tokens, only a memory of fixed size that the text writes into, heads that each forget at their own rate, the same cost at any length, and what the memory puzzles measured. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-sdm-lookback))_
- **SDM-UNFOLD**: How a word goes into our SDM language models and how a word comes out: enfold turns a token into a vector, every layer adds to it, and unfold scores every word against the same word table. It also draws the address that finds a few slots among thousands. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-sdm-unfold))_
- **SDMCHAT**: An SDM used as a language model, running as a live chat in the browser. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#sdmchat))_
- **SDMCHAT-MODEL**: The SDM language model's page: the law (all SDM, no transformer, from scratch), the two newest models, FULL and PARTIAL, with their scores and the one we take forward, then the history: every training run's shape and TEST score, the sweeps in plain words with their walls, and the honest reading of where we were. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-sdmchat-model))_
- **SDMCHATS**: The experiment that put every SDM chat surface (SDMCHAT, SDMPOEM, SDMJEV, WEIRD LITTLE SDM GUY) on models that read an SDM, trained the wide-address SDM read at width 512, and added the loop guards to the sampler. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-sdmchats))_
- **SDMCODED**: The experiment whose question was: Does compressing a note before storing it let more text fit and come back exactly, and is an error-correcting code worth its space? _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-sdmcoded))_
- **SDMEXPLORE**: The experiment that built the SDM state machine of the SDM EXPLORE page: a JavaScript port of settle-rs's sdm family. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-sdmexplore))_
- **SDMJEV**: The model magic-8-ball: a yes, unsure or no decision read in one pass from SDMCHAT's vector space and settled into one of the twenty classic answers. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#sdmjev))_
- **SDMKEYS**: The experiment whose question was: How does Kanerva's SDM compare with Hopfield on capacity, fake valleys and fade, and what does a key cost and protect? _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-sdmkeys))_
- **SDMKIT**: The experiment that lifted SETTLE's SDM code into KANERVA, a standalone Rust crate with no dependencies. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-sdmkit))_
- **SDMMEMORY**: Live Hopfield recall, an SDM room of lights, the softness dial and keyed notes, then the record. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-sdmmemory))_
- **SDMNEXT**: The experiment that trained the width 768 SDM read further on chat turns and its no-store control at width 768, and scored both on the same held-out windows. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-sdmnext))_
- **SDMPOEM**: The SDM language model writing verse live, then THE POEM LAB: an SDM that learns a whole poem in the tab and recites it. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-sdmpoem))_
- **SDMRADIUS**: The experiment whose question was: If the SDM's radius is chosen for the damage it must survive, does 30% capacity grow with the number of locations, and does a pulls read scaled to the store's density work? _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-sdmradius))_
- **SDMREFUSE**: The experiment that built a refusal rule for the SDM's top-k and wide-radius reads, from the race margin. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-sdmrefuse))_
- **SDMSTUDIO**: A little ML studio in the browser: post-train one of the site's SDM chat models on a licensed dataset or your own text, with loss curves, samples, checkpoints and a file tree of your runs. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#sdmstudio))_
- **SETTLE-TOUR**: How a settling machine learns to read handwritten digits: a guide, MNIST live, then the 8x8 experiments as recorded. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-settle-tour))_
- **SETTLEBACKENDS**: The experiment whose question was: When a SETTLE model is exported to other samplers' formats, do thrml, dwave-samplers and exact enumeration agree with it? _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-settlebackends))_
- **SETTLEZOO**: The experiment whose question was: How often does annealing find the exact answer to a hard puzzle, against sweeps and size? _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-settlezoo))_
- **SMOOTHNUMBERS**: The experiment whose question was: Does settling solve linear systems, and how does the error fall with settling time? _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-smoothnumbers))_
- **soft read**: A picture drawn from each light's running average, rather than from its bits, which are fully on or off. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#soft-read))_
- **SONIQUE RING**: 32 rays all the way round, low notes at the top, the ring turning slowly. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#sonique-ring))_
- **SOUND**: The hero's sound button: off on load, in the hot pink action style while off. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#sound))_
- **SPARK24**: The experiment that trained SDMCHAT's newer models on 300M tokens of FineWeb-Edu and scored them on the same held-out windows as SDMLLMSTORE. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-spark24))_
- **spike**: A pulse travelling along a wire in the footer's brain picture. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#spike))_
- **SURPRISE**: A first-person game whose settling agent acts to keep its surprise low: Friston's free-energy principle in toy form. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-surprise))_
- **THE BASES**: A house or ambient rhythm bed in our own JSON (settle-base/1): a tempo, a meter, a key and separate parts (kick, snare, hats, bass, chords and more) as events on a grid. The library on #/hear holds 300: 150 house, 150 ambient; 224 imported from open MIDI, 76 authored from theory. The ledger keeps each base's source and licence. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#base))_
- **THE DJ**: The part of the hero symphony that picks the flute and old tunes from the picture, shown as one line at the bottom of the hero. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#the-dj))_
- **THE DJ SYSTEM**: THE DJ and everything around it on the home page hero: the sound modes, the set line and its controls, the rate marks, and listening together, where listeners share their DJ's settings and can follow each other's DJ. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#the-dj-system))_
- **THE DUET**: The one neon treatment worn wherever SETTLE and KANERVA meet: SETTLE's purple runs into KANERVA's cyan, in a paired mark (two interlocked rings and the two names), a two-tone rule and the band that holds them. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#duet))_
- **the filesystem menu**: The site as a tree under /settle with folders, an ls -l listing, one mark per page and a preview; the second row is the tour, the recommended order. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#filesystem-menu))_
- **THE FILM PLAYER**: A grid of p-bits playing film frames live, every stage shown: target, leans, lights, bits and the error map. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-film))_
- **the footer**: A live picture of two layers of the brain at the end of every page, docked as a 50 px strip until you scroll to it. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#footer-brain))_
- **the global settle**: One registry of every settle on the page and one ripple that crosses them all: a ring of lights and a brief warming spreads from a click. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#global-settle))_
- **the kanji mark**: The brand mark: the kanji 定 (settle, fix) drawn as a dot matrix of lights in the prime red with a touch of neon. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#kanji-mark))_
- **the master beat**: One clock for the whole site: TRUE TIME ticks of 500 ms, a 120 bpm beat, a 2 s bar and the 25 ms flash of the 40 Hz light, all counted from one origin. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#master-beat))_
- **the navigator**: The person who directs this work: he charts the course and makes the calls. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#the-navigator))_
- **THE NEON CODE**: Ten neons, each meaning one thing in every picture: yes rose, no indigo, lean amber, pull cyan, heat orange, calm lime, memory violet, held ice, data mint, miss red. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#neon-code))_
- **THE PAPER**: "On the Lime and the Coconut": SETTLE's whole mathematics as one very short paper. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-paper))_
- **the red-light rule**: The site's chrome emits red light only, 600 nm and up, with a few named exceptions: the pinks, the purple highlight, the code purple, and the logo's own lights (its touch neons and its PLAIN WHITE moment). _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#red-light-rule))_
- **THE SOUND MODES**: The three ways the hero's shuffle deals its turns: MEDITATE MODE, DJ MODE and BINAURAL. One holds at a time. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#sound-modes))_
- **the strip**: The hero folded small: a 25 px still strip on other pages, or a 60 px live bar once pinned or scrolled away; the footer has a 50 px strip of its own. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#hero-strip))_
- **THE TWO PANELS**: The two kinds of panel around a block of text. The purple panel holds SETTLE and KANERVA code and stays stock standard, because it stands for a standard library. The orange notation panel, a chamfered frame around a paragraph of our own notation, is ours. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#two-panels))_
- **the what chains**: Small shimmering words on the WHAT page that open in place into a short chain of lines, each chain in one neon. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#what-chains))_
- **TRUE TIME**: The hero's time system, and the name of its main playlist. A film keeps its own pace behind, and the field in front settles toward whatever frame is current, frame by frame; the playlist is the hero's films and still pictures, played on shuffle in that time. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#true-time))_
- **VALLEYMAP**: The experiment whose question was: How many valleys does a settle landscape have, how wide, how regular, and what is the shape good for? _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-valleymap))_
- **VISUALISERS**: The hero's second bag: eight pictures of the sound, after the old music players, one slot in every eight. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#visualisers))_
- **VU METERS**: Two needles: the left reads the sound below 500 Hz, the right the sound above it. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#vu-meters))_
- **WEIRD LITTLE SDM GUY**: A small SDM language model with one obsession, how we know things, and his tiny paper on one title page. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#weirdlittlesdmguy))_
- **WEIRDGUY**: The experiment that made WEIRD LITTLE SDM GUY: SDMCHAT's SDM-read model fine-tuned on a corpus of our own. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-weirdguy))_
- **WHAT**: What SETTLE is, step by step, in two halves: SETTLE, then KANERVA. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-what))_
- **WHO YOU ARE**: Three guides on one page, one per reader: a programmer, a visual artist, a sound artist. Each explains SETTLE, KANERVA and settle-mcp in that reader's terms, with an example and its output. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#page-who-you-are))_
- **WINAMP BARS**: The house set as chunky bars, low notes left, each with a cap that hangs and falls. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#winamp-bars))_
- **WINAMP SCOPE**: The sound wave as a row of dots, as an oscilloscope draws it. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#winamp-scope))_
- **Yayoi Kusama**: The artist of the infinity mirrored room that the site's brand picture comes from. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#yayoi-kusama))_
- **ZOOHARD**: The experiment whose question was: How does annealing fare on hard sudoku, on graph colouring near the threshold, and on factoring written column by column with carries? _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lane-zoohard))_

## site index: Kanerva

- **access circle**: The hard locations within the activation radius of an address: the ones a read or a write touches. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#access-circle))_
- **activation probability**: The fraction of hard locations one address activates, Kanerva's p; SETTLE derives the activation radius from it. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#activation-probability))_
- **activation radius**: The Hamming distance within which an address activates a hard location. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#activation-radius))_
- **address matrix**: Kanerva's A: the hard locations' fixed random addresses, one row each. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#address-matrix))_
- **address register**: The register holding the address being written or read. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#address-register))_
- **address-noise**: The fraction of a read-address's bits flipped at random before the read. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#address-noise))_
- **analogy**: X is to Y as A is to B, worked out by binding and unbinding hypervectors. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#analogy))_
- **autoassociative**: A memory that stores each word at its own address, so a noisy copy reads it back. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#autoassociative))_
- **best-match**: Finding the stored word nearest a given word, the problem an SDM answers approximately. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#best-match))_
- **binary spatter code**: Kanerva's binary hypervectors: XOR to bind, the bitwise majority to bundle. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#binary-spatter-code))_
- **bit-counters**: The integer counters each hard location keeps, one per bit of the data word; a write adds +1 or -1 to each. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#bit-counters))_
- **clean-up**: The last step of a hyperdimensional answer: compare the noisy result with every word in the item memory and take the word it looks most like. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#clean-up))_
- **climbing fibre**: In Kanerva's model of the cerebellum, the line that brings a Purkinje cell the word to be stored. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#climbing-fibre))_
- **concentration of measure**: In many dimensions nearly every random point lies about the same distance from any given one; for n bits, close to n/2. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#concentration-of-measure))_
- **contents matrix**: Kanerva's C: every hard location's bit-counters together, one row per hard location. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#contents-matrix))_
- **critical distance**: How far a read-address can be from a stored word and still converge to it under iterated reads, on average: near it single reads can go either way, and it moves in as more words are stored. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#critical-distance))_
- **data word**: The word stored and read back. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#data-word))_
- **FHRR**: Plate's complex form of HRR: every number is a unit phasor, binding multiplies the phasors, and unbinding by the conjugate is exact. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#fhrr))_
- **granule cell**: In Kanerva's model of the cerebellum, a hard location: very many of them, each woken by a few mossy fibres. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#granule-cell))_
- **Hamming ball**: Every address within a given Hamming distance of a centre; the Hamming distance counts the bits two words differ in. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#hamming-ball))_
- **Hamming distance**: The number of bit positions in which two words differ. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#hamming-distance))_
- **hard location**: One of the memory locations that is actually built, each with a fixed random address. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#hard-location))_
- **heteroassociative**: A memory that stores a word at another word's address: a pairing, or the next step of a sequence. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#heteroassociative))_
- **holographic reduced representation**: Plate's vector symbolic architecture: real-valued vectors bound by circular convolution, and unbound by convolving with the involution, which returns a noisy copy for a clean-up. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#holographic-reduced-representation))_
- **hyperdimensional computing**: Computing with very long random words, about ten thousand bits, using binding, adding and permuting. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#hyperdimensional-computing))_
- **item memory**: The store of named random hypervectors that a clean-up compares a noisy answer with. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#item-memory))_
- **iterated reads**: Reading again at the last answer: the most times a read uses its own result as the next read-address. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#iterated-reads))_
- **Kanerva**: Pentti Kanerva, who invented sparse distributed memory and wrote the hyperdimensional computing papers this site leans on. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#pentti-kanerva))_
- **majority rule**: Bundling's last step: each bit takes the value most of the summed vectors hold. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#majority-rule))_
- **mossy fibre**: In Kanerva's model of the cerebellum, the input lines that carry the address. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#mossy-fibre))_
- **nearest neighbour**: The stored word closest to a given one; an SDM read finds it approximately. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#nearest-neighbour))_
- **permutation**: Rotating or shuffling a hypervector's bits in a fixed way: the operation that marks order or position. Under circular-convolution binding only a shuffle works: a rotation passes through the bind and marks nothing. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#permutation))_
- **quasi-orthogonal**: Two random hypervectors are almost perpendicular: they differ in close to half their bits. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#quasi-orthogonal))_
- **random address**: A hard location's address, drawn at random once and never changed. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#random-address))_
- **read-address**: The address you read a memory at. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#read-address))_
- **read-threshold**: A read sums the bit-counters of the activated hard locations and keeps each bit whose sum is above 0. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#read-threshold))_
- **role-filler binding**: A role vector bound to a filler vector, so a bundled record can be taken apart again by unbinding. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#role-filler-binding))_
- **sequence**: A sequence is stored by writing each word at the address of the one before it, so reading at one word recalls the next. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#sequence-memory))_
- **sparse coding**: Codes in which most bits are 0 and only a few are 1. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#sparse-coding))_
- **sparse distributed memory**: Pentti Kanerva's memory: a word is written to many hard locations near its address and read back by their vote, even from a noisy address. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#sparse-distributed-memory))_
- **the dollar of Mexico**: Kanerva's example of computing with long random words: bind country and money, then unbind to ask what Mexico's dollar is (the peso). _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#dollar-of-mexico))_
- **tolerate-noise:**: The address-noise a memory is sized to tolerate; SETTLE picks the activation radius that recalls best at that noise. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#tolerate-noise))_
- **TRACK**: KANERVA's tracking prediction of how many words a memory holds and how often a read fails, which follows the measured recall where the plain S-map promises too many. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#track-prediction))_
- **unbinding**: Bind a bundled record with a role again (XOR), or convolve it with the role's involution (HRR), and a noisy copy of its filler comes back out. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#unbinding))_
- **vector symbolic architecture**: The family of algebras on wide vectors: a bind, a bundle and a permutation. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#vector-symbolic-architecture))_
- **vote**: How an SDM read decides each bit: the activated hard locations add their counters and the sign wins. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#vote))_
- **word size**: The number of bits in an address and in a data word; SETTLE uses one length for both. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#word-size))_
- **write-address**: The address a data word is stored at. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#write-address))_
- **XOR**: The bind of Kanerva's hyperdimensional computing: c = a XOR b, bit by bit. Tying again with b gives back a, so a tie can be undone. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#xor-bind))_

## KANERVA term

- **access-circle (prose)**: The hard-locations within the activation-radius of an address. K1988 calls the set the access circle. _(SETTLE/kanerva/KANERVA_TERMS.md)_
- **activation-probability:**: The fraction of hard-locations one address activates. SETTLE derives the activation-radius from it. _(SETTLE/kanerva/KANERVA_TERMS.md)_
- **activation-radius:**: The Hamming distance within which a hard-location is activated by an address. _(SETTLE/kanerva/KANERVA_TERMS.md)_
- **address-noise:**: The fraction of the read-address's bits flipped at random before the read. `address-noise: 0.2` flips a fifth of them. _(SETTLE/kanerva/KANERVA_TERMS.md)_
- **best-match (prose)**: Finding the stored word nearest a given word. K1988's term index lists the "Best-Match Machine". _(SETTLE/kanerva/KANERVA_TERMS.md)_
- **bit-counters (prose)**: The integer counters each hard-location keeps, one per bit of the data word. A write adds +1 or -1 to each. _(SETTLE/kanerva/KANERVA_TERMS.md)_
- **critical-distance (prose)**: How far a read-address can be from a stored word and still converge to it under iterated reads. _(SETTLE/kanerva/KANERVA_TERMS.md)_
- **data-word (prose)**: The word stored and read back. In SETTLE's autoassociative memories the data word is the pattern itself. _(SETTLE/kanerva/KANERVA_TERMS.md)_
- **hard-locations:**: The memory locations that are built, each with a fixed random address. _(SETTLE/kanerva/KANERVA_TERMS.md)_
- **iterated-reads:**: The most times a read uses its own result as the next read-address. The read stops early when the result stops changing. _(SETTLE/kanerva/KANERVA_TERMS.md)_
- **read-address:**: The address you read at. SETTLE says read because the statement is `s.read`. _(SETTLE/kanerva/KANERVA_TERMS.md)_
- **read-threshold (prose)**: A read sums the bit-counters of the activated hard-locations and keeps each bit whose sum is positive. _(SETTLE/kanerva/KANERVA_TERMS.md)_
- **tolerate-noise:**: The address-noise a memory is sized to tolerate. SETTLE picks the activation-radius that recalls best at that noise. _(SETTLE/kanerva/KANERVA_TERMS.md)_
- **word-size:**: The number of bits in an address and in a data word. SETTLE uses one length for both. _(SETTLE/kanerva/KANERVA_TERMS.md)_
- **write-address (prose; s.write :cat names it)**: The address a word is stored at. _(SETTLE/kanerva/KANERVA_TERMS.md)_

## SETTLE word

- **activated**: A hard location is activated for a pattern when its address is within the activation radius of that pattern: _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdm.md)_
- **activation radius**: A hard location is activated for a pattern when its address is within the activation radius of that pattern: _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdm.md)_
- **address**: an address: a fixed random pattern of word-size values, drawn once when the memory is declared and never changed; _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdm.md)_
- **address things**: address things s_addr_0 to s_addr_<n - 1>. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/softsdm.md)_
- **basin**: The basin of a valley is the share of all 2^n arrangements whose steepest descent ends in it. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/valleys.md)_
- **bit-counters**: a row of bit-counters: one number for each of the word-size positions, all zero at the start. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdm.md)_
- **block**: Block wakes every hard location whose match exceeds a threshold theta. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdmtrack.md)_
- **blue**: The run's yes-counts hold the blue channel's last-frame counts and zero for every other thing, because each channel's frame replaces the counts and blue is played last. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/colour.md)_
- **claim**: The return value is the claim: _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/07-extending.md)_
- **core**: The first three programs use the core family and the fourth uses sdm. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/02-tour.md)_
- **data things**: data things s_data_0 to s_data_<n - 1>. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/softsdm.md)_
- **doubt**: Where the snapshots disagree, the cloud has doubt: the mutual information between the prediction and the parameters, _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/descend.md)_
- **energy**: Every arrangement of the things has an energy. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/02-tour.md)_
- **families**: SETTLE's statements are grouped into families. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/07-extending.md)_
- **family**: Every SETTLE statement belongs to a family: one Rust file in src/ that implements the Ext trait (see Extending SETTLE). _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **flat floor**: If some flips leave the energy unchanged, the valley is the whole flat floor: every arrangement reachable from it by such flips. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/valleys.md)_
- **fresh**: FRESH draws it anew each round, k_mu ~ Poisson(p M q_mu). _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdmtrack.md)_
- **hard location things**: hard location things s_loc_0 to s_loc_<M - 1>. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/softsdm.md)_
- **hard locations**: The memory has 1,000 hard locations: fixed random addresses, each with a counter for every bit. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/02-tour.md)_
- **helper things**: Each check is built from extra helper things and a penalty P_r that is zero exactly when the check holds and the helpers take their right values, and at least 1 otherwise. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/ldpcsettle.md)_
- **iterated**: The read is iterated: the result becomes the next read-address, and the read repeats until the result stops changing (a fixed point) or the iteration limit is reached. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdm.md)_
- **keyword arguments**: Keyword arguments come last: a label followed by one value token (by: 2, seed: 1, as: :ising), optionally separated by commas. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/03-syntax.md)_
- **lean**: A lean for each thing, a real number h. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/04-semantics.md)_
- **loss**: The descend family settles continuous parameters on a loss. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/descend.md)_
- **mirror image**: A mirror image of an arrangement has every free thing flipped. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/valleys.md)_
- **model block**: A model block, model :name do ... end, describes a probability distribution. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/02-tour.md)_
- **parameters**: The descend family settles continuous parameters on a loss. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/descend.md)_
- **persist**: PERSIST keeps each hard location's rank from round to round: when q_mu rises it adds Poisson(p M (q_mu - q_mu_before)) hard locations, and when it falls it keeps each woken hard location with probability q_mu / q_mu_before. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdmtrack.md)_
- **positional arguments**: Positional arguments come first: symbols, numbers or strings, separated by commas, in the order the statement defines. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/03-syntax.md)_
- **pull**: A pull for each pair of things, a real number J. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/04-semantics.md)_
- **read-address**: s.read read-address: :cat, address-noise: 0.2 flips 20% of cat's bits and reads from that copy, the read-address. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/02-tour.md)_
- **reading**: Reading from a read-address z lets the hard locations activated by z vote, position by position: _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdm.md)_
- **receiver**: A receiver is the name of a thing or of a structure built by a statement, written as an identifier (no colon): rain.pulls, img.show_as, m.recall. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/03-syntax.md)_
- **run block**: A run block, run :name do ... end, works with the model of the same name. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/02-tour.md)_
- **run state**: run :name do creates a fresh run state for the model. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/04-semantics.md)_
- **saddle**: A flat floor that has a way down from one of its members is a saddle, not a valley. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/valleys.md)_
- **sdm**: The first three programs use the core family and the fourth uses sdm. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/02-tour.md)_
- **steepest descent**: Steepest descent from an arrangement takes the flip with the most negative dE_i until none is negative. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/valleys.md)_
- **t = 0**: T = 0 is gradient descent. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/descend.md)_
- **t = 1**: T = 1 samples the posterior exp(-U). _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/descend.md)_
- **t > 1**: T > 1 samples a flattened posterior exp(-U / T), wider than the evidence supports. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/descend.md)_
- **things**: Things, in the order they were declared. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/04-semantics.md)_
- **top-k**: Top-k wakes the k = max(1, round(p M)) filled hard locations whose match C_i . z with the state is largest. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdmtrack.md)_
- **travel**: The memory can still see how far the read moved: the Hamming distance from the read-address to the answer, called the travel. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdmrefuse.md)_
- **valley**: A valley is an arrangement from which no single flip goes downhill. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/valleys.md)_
- **verb**: The verb is an identifier: thing, settle, ask, grid, play. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/03-syntax.md)_
- **with hidden things**: With hidden things (a restricted machine), the learnable pulls are every pair of one visible thing and one hidden thing. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/learn.md)_
- **without hidden things**: Without hidden things (a fully visible machine), the learnable pulls are every pair of visible things. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/learn.md)_
- **word size**: A pattern is 128 bits, the word size. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/02-tour.md)_
- **writing**: Writing a pattern p adds it to the bit-counters of every hard location activated by p: _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdm.md)_

## KANERVA module

- **address**: a named address matrix, the activated set, Kanerva's iterated read over bit-counters held by the caller _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **address_noise**: recall as the read-address gets noisier, beside the predicted critical-distance _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **bit_balance**: words whose bits lean one way, and how few of them the memory holds _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **bits**: `i8` and bit-packed patterns, Hamming distance, address-noise, best-match (nearest neighbour) _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **calibrated**: the calibrated refusal (SDMTRACK's calibrated minimum) over the address or the content read _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **calibrated_refusal**: the travel rule and the calibrated refusal on a light and a crowded store _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **capacity**: write more and more words and watch recall fall, beside the predicted capacity _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **codes**: FNV-1a seeds, named ±1 patterns, text as bits, text masked by its name, overlap, address-noise _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **content_read**: the address read and the content-woken read side by side at heavy load _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **diagnose**: the bit balance of a set of words; the race between a target and its rivals for shared hard-locations _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **erase**: the exact undo of a write, and the leave-one-out read _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **hetero**: a data-word of its own width written at an address, with int32 bit-counters and a radius or nearest-k wake _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **hopfield**: the zero-temperature Hopfield baseline sized to a pull budget _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **keyed_notes**: notes that only their key reads back _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **keys**: keyed notes: a key names a rotation of the cube, finds its note and reads it _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **lang**: the one parser and runner for `.kanerva` files and SETTLE's sdm-family lines _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **negative_controls**: shuffle the bit-counters and the memory forgets _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **quickstart**: the whole tour in one program; its output is under "Example output" below _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **rails**: SETTLE's sdm-family programs written with the builder, printing SETTLE's own lines _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **refusal**: stored words are accepted, never-stored read-addresses are refused _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **refuse**: travel threshold, the exact best-match oracle, diagnostic reads, predictor TRACK for the address read _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **rng**: xorshift64* generator: uniform, signed, bounded, normal _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **sdm**: the front door: `Sdm`, `ReadResult`, `Refusal`, `SoftSdm` and the word helpers _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **sizing**: the SNR radius against a radius tuned for 30% noise; TRACK and the S-map against measured recall _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **smap**: the S-map: critical-distance, capacity, activation-radius for an address-noise level; averaged noise, mirror field, Poisson first read, RACE _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **soft**: the soft machine: p-bit hard-locations with a softness dial, pass and settle reads, mean field, kernel, softmax-attention read _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **soft_memory**: recall and the attention inverse temperature as softness rises _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **store**: `Store`: one-byte bit-counters for 10^5 to 10^6 hard-locations; address, threshold and top-k reads; row and entry shuffles; density-scaled thresholds _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **theory**: binomial tables, the Hamming ball, the intersection of two balls, the activation-radius for an activation probability, the normal CDF _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **track**: predictors for the content-woken reads (TRACK-C, TRACK-G, TRACK-R), read traces, censuses, calibrated refusal scores _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **words**: the one word list: every statement, its keywords, their kinds and defaults _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_
- **write_and_read**: write 20 words and read one back from a noisy read-address _(SETTLE/kanerva/README.md)_

## SETTLE statement

- **anneal**: Search for the calmest arrangement by cooling. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/core.md)_
- **anneal_each**: anneal, and let every puzzle keep its own calmest block _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/zoo.md)_
- **anneal_schedule**: anneal with chosen hot and cold ends, in one or several walks _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/zootemp.md)_
- **ask**: Print the fraction of samples in which a combination holds. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/core.md)_
- **best**: Print the calmest arrangement the last `anneal` found. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/core.md)_
- **c.decode**: decode the received word by annealing, and report a codeword or refuse _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/ldpcsettle.md)_
- **c.decode_bp**: decode the received word by belief propagation _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/ldpcsettle.md)_
- **c.decode_moves**: anneal from the received word with moves that carry each bit's checks with it _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/ldpcmoves.md)_
- **c.decode_nishimori**: stay at temperature 1, average each bit, take the majority _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/ldpcmoves.md)_
- **c.transmit**: send a random message through a random-flip channel _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/ldpcsettle.md)_
- **classify**: hold the inputs of each row, settle, and read the label _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/learn.md)_
- **coins**: draw samples with every pixel an independent coin _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/denoise.md)_
- **colour**: declare three grids, one per channel _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/colour.md)_
- **colouring**: declare a graph colouring with 2 to 9 colours _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/zoo.md)_
- **contenttrack**: print TRACK-C's predicted recall for a content read, a size, a load and a address-noise _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdmtrack.md)_
- **d.generate**: draw samples by settling down the chain from coin noise _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/denoise.md)_
- **d.train**: fit every machine of the chain to an examples set _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/denoise.md)_
- **data**: the examples a loss is fitted to: a CSV file, or MNIST _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/descend.md)_
- **denoiser**: declare a chain of restricted machines _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/denoise.md)_
- **descend**: settle the parameters: Langevin above temperature 0, gradient descent at 0, or Adam _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/descend.md)_
- **drift**: settle the model's springs by noisy drift _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/numbers.md)_
- **examples**: declare a set of examples from a file or inline, or add rows to one _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/learn.md)_
- **export**: write the model, or the last settle or anneal, to a file _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/export.md)_
- **factor**: declare the factoring of an odd whole number _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/zoo.md)_
- **grid**: declare a width x height block of pixel things with neighbour pulls _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/grid.md)_
- **hidden**: add hidden things, making a restricted machine _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/learn.md)_
- **hold**: Fix a thing at yes or no for the rest of the run block. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/core.md)_
- **img.lean_from**: set every pixel's lean from a greyscale picture _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/grid.md)_
- **img.show_as**: write the pixels' yes-rates or last states as a picture _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/grid.md)_
- **import**: read a `settle-ising` file: things, leans and pulls (model), or held things and temperature (run) _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/export.md)_
- **landscape**: build a random, grid, ring or code landscape _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/valleys.md)_
- **ldpc**: declare an LDPC code as code-bit things, helper things and pulls _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/ldpcsettle.md)_
- **learn**: fit leans and pulls to a set of examples _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/learn.md)_
- **loss**: the loss piece: springs, least squares, logistic, or a one-hidden-layer net _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/descend.md)_
- **maxcut**: declare a max-cut problem on a weighted graph _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/zoo.md)_
- **means**: the settled averages against an exact solve _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/numbers.md)_
- **memory**: declare a memory: a block of free things _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/memory.md)_
- **name.attend**: compute three limit reads outside the sampler and compare them _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/softsdm.md)_
- **name.fill**: write a number of unnamed random patterns, as load _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdmscale.md)_
- **name.put**: write a named random pattern _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdmscale.md)_
- **name.read**: read from a noisy read-address, a key or noise, and report what came back _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdm.md)_
- **name.recall**: shake from a read-address, a key or noise, and report what the memory settled on _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/memory.md)_
- **name.recall_coded**: shake or read from a read-address, then decode, check and print the text or refuse _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/coded.md)_
- **name.remember**: store a random pattern named by a symbol _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/memory.md)_
- **name.save**: store text, in the open or under a key _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/memory.md)_
- **name.save_coded**: compress, error-code, mask and store a text note in a memory or an sdm _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/coded.md)_
- **name.write**: write a random pattern, a text, or a text under a key _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdm.md)_
- **nonogram**: declare a nonogram: a picture drawn from row and column clues _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/zoo.md)_
- **number**: declare real-valued numbers _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/numbers.md)_
- **play**: reproduce every frame of a folder of pictures, one after another _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/grid.md)_
- **play_colour**: reproduce every frame of a folder of colour pictures _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/colour.md)_
- **refusal**: print the travel rule's threshold and the nearest-neighbour ceiling for a size and a load _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdmrefuse.md)_
- **sample**: draw samples by settling the model's own things _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/denoise.md)_
- **score**: accuracy, log-likelihood, calibration and doubt on the test examples _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/descend.md)_
- **sdm**: declare a sparse distributed memory _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdm.md)_
- **sdmscale**: declare a large sparse distributed memory _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/sdmscale.md)_
- **settle**: Draw samples by Gibbs sampling. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/core.md)_
- **show**: Print each thing's yes-rate over the last `settle`. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/core.md)_
- **shuffle**: scramble which labels go with which row _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/learn.md)_
- **softsdm**: declare a soft sparse distributed memory _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/softsdm.md)_
- **solve**: build springs for `A x = b` from a matrix, settle them and check the answer _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/numbers.md)_
- **spread**: the covariance and the inverse matrix it gives _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/numbers.md)_
- **sudoku**: declare a 4x4 or 9x9 sudoku _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/zoo.md)_
- **survey**: estimate the valleys by shaking and quenching from many random starts _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/valleys.md)_
- **test**: held-out examples that `score` predicts _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/descend.md)_
- **thing**: Declare things, optionally with a lean. _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/core.md)_
- **valleys**: list every valley and its exact basin (up to 24 free things) _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/valleys.md)_
- **x.final**: decode a puzzle from the run's last arrangement and check it _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/zootemp.md)_
- **x.leans_to**: a spring tying a number to a fixed value _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/numbers.md)_
- **x.opposes**: a spring pulling one number toward minus another _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/numbers.md)_
- **x.solution**: decode a puzzle from the calmest arrangement and check it _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/zoo.md)_
- **x.springs**: a spring pulling two numbers together _(SETTLE/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/numbers.md)_

## site index: SETTLE keywords

- **anneal**: Settles while cooling, sweep by sweep, and keeps the calmest arrangement it finds. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#anneal))_
- **anneal_schedule**: Runs several anneals with a chosen cooling schedule; x.final judges the puzzle on the last arrangement. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#anneal-schedule))_
- **ask**: Counts how often a thing, or a combination of things, was yes in the recorded samples. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#ask))_
- **best**: Prints the calmest arrangement the last anneal found, with its energy. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#best))_
- **burn:**: How many early sweeps or steps are thrown away before samples are counted. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#burn))_
- **by:**: The strength of a lean or a pull. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#by))_
- **classify**: Scores a learned machine: hold an example's pixels and settle the label things. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#classify))_
- **coded**: Compress and error-code text before storing it in a memory; decode it on recall. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-coded))_
- **colour**: Three grids per colour picture: PPM in and out, colour playback. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-colour))_
- **contenttrack**: Predicts how well a memory's content reads will recall, without building the memory. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#contenttrack))_
- **core**: Things, leans and pulls; hold, settle, anneal, show, best and ask. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-core))_
- **denoise**: A chain of small machines trained to turn coin noise into examples. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-denoise))_
- **denoiser**: A chain of small machines trained to turn coin noise into examples, step by step. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#denoiser))_
- **descend**: Gradient descent as settling: parameters on a differentiable loss, Langevin noise above temperature 0, the posterior cloud. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-descend))_
- **drift**: Lets the numbers drift under Langevin noise; means and spread read the cloud; solve does it for A x = b. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#drift))_
- **end**: The line that closes a block; `do` ends the line that opens one. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#end))_
- **examples**: Reads an example set for learning; hidden declares hidden things the machine may use. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#examples))_
- **export**: Write a model as Ising, QUBO, Gset or DIMACS; read an Ising file back. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-export))_
- **fade:**: A factor every counter or pull is multiplied by before each write, so old words fade. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#fade))_
- **gain:**: The data input one clean stored pattern gives in a soft memory. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#gain))_
- **grid**: One thing per pixel: read and write PGM pictures, play a folder of frames. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-grid))_
- **hold**: Pins a thing to :yes or :no for the rest of the run block: what was seen. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#hold))_
- **key:**: Stores or reads text under a key: SETTLE's keyed notes. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#key))_
- **ldpc**: An LDPC error-correcting code as springs: transmit through a noisy channel, then decode by settling or by belief propagation. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#ldpc))_
- **ldpcmoves**: Multi-bit moves and Nishimori-temperature decoding for those codes. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-ldpcmoves))_
- **ldpcsettle**: LDPC error-correcting codes as springs; decode by settling or by belief propagation. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-ldpcsettle))_
- **lean**: How much one thing wants to be yes on its own, before any pull: its field. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lean))_
- **lean_from**: Sets every pixel's lean from a picture file. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#lean-from))_
- **learn**: Example sets, hidden things, Boltzmann machine learning, classification by settling. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-learn))_
- **level:**: The largest allowed chance that a read accepts a read-address that was never stored. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#level))_
- **load:**: How many random patterns the memory holds, for the refusal and recall predictions. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#load))_
- **memory**: A Hopfield memory: patterns and text stored in the pulls, recalled from a damaged read-address, keyed notes. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-memory))_
- **mode:**: A soft read's mode: a one-way pass, or a joint settle with feedback. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#mode))_
- **model block**: The block that declares a machine: its things, leans, pulls and any larger structure such as a grid or a memory. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#model-block))_
- **number**: Declares a real-valued thing, a number, for the springs family. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#number))_
- **numbers**: Real-valued things on springs, Langevin drift, solving linear systems. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-numbers))_
- **play**: Plays a folder of picture frames through a grid, settling each frame from the last. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#play))_
- **pull**: A coupling between two things that makes them agree; a push is a negative pull that makes them disagree. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#pull))_
- **read**: Reads a memory at a read-address: the activated hard locations vote, bit by bit, and the read repeats from its own answer. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#read))_
- **recall**: Reads a pattern back from a Hopfield memory by settling from a noisy read-address. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#recall))_
- **refusal**: Computes when a memory read should refuse to answer: when the read-address was never stored. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#refusal))_
- **remember**: Stores a pattern (or a line of text) in a Hopfield memory's pulls. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#remember))_
- **rounds:**: How many passes or reads a statement makes. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#rounds))_
- **run block**: The block that runs a declared model: it holds things, settles, anneals, shows and asks. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#run-block))_
- **run state**: What a run block remembers between its statements: the temperature, the random generator, the held things and the last samples. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#run-state))_
- **samples:**: How many samples each soft read takes. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#samples))_
- **save**: Stores text in a memory under a key, so it can be read back with the key. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#save))_
- **save_coded**: Compresses and error-codes text, then stores it; recall_coded reads it back and decodes it. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#save-coded))_
- **sdm**: Kanerva sparse distributed memory with hard locations and bit-counters. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-sdm))_
- **sdmrefuse**: When a sparse distributed memory read should refuse to answer. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-sdmrefuse))_
- **sdmscale**: Sparse distributed memory at scale, up to a million hard locations. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-sdmscale))_
- **sdmtrack**: Predicted recall of a sparse distributed memory's content reads, without building the memory. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-sdmtrack))_
- **seed:**: The keyword that replaces a run's random generator with one seeded by a number, so a run repeats exactly. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#seed))_
- **settle**: The statement that settles a model: N Gibbs sweeps at a temperature, recording one sample per sweep. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#settle-stmt))_
- **show**: Prints one line per thing: how often it was yes in the last settle, with a bar. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#show))_
- **show_as**: Writes the grid as a picture file. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#show-as))_
- **softness:**: How wide the soft edge of the activation radius is; 0 is hard SDM. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#softness))_
- **softsdm**: Sparse distributed memory built from p-bits, with a soft cut-off. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-softsdm))_
- **solution**: Takes the best arrangement of the last anneal, decodes the puzzle from it and checks it in plain code. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#solution))_
- **springs**: Ties numbers together with springs: springs pulls two together, opposes pulls one toward minus the other, leans_to ties one to a value. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#springs))_
- **statement family**: One Rust file of settle-rs that adds a group of statements, such as core, memory or sdm. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#statement-family))_
- **sudoku**: Turns a puzzle into leans and pulls: sudoku, graph colouring, max-cut and factoring. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#sudoku))_
- **symbol**: A word with a colon in front, such as :rain; a thing's name and the values :yes and :no are symbols. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#symbol))_
- **temperature:**: The keyword that sets a run's temperature, for this statement and the ones after it. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#temperature-kw))_
- **thing**: A yes-or-no unit of a program; the statement `thing` declares one or more and can give them a lean. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#thing))_
- **valleys**: Test landscapes; exact enumeration and random surveys of the calm arrangements. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-valleys))_
- **via:**: Which read an sdm runs: Kanerva's read by addresses, or a zero-temperature settle of the pulls. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#via))_
- **wake:**: How a pulls read chooses which hard locations activate: fixed, by density, or the top ones. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#wake))_
- **write**: Writes a data word into a memory at its write-address: each activated hard location adds it to its bit-counters. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#write))_
- **write-samples:**: How many activated tries each soft write samples per hard location. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#write-samples))_
- **zoo**: Puzzles as models: sudoku, graph colouring, max-cut and factoring, and checking a solution. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-zoo))_
- **zootemp**: An anneal with a chosen schedule and restarts; judging a puzzle on the end state. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#family-zootemp))_

## site index: science

- **annealing schedule**: How the temperature falls during annealing; cooled too fast, a system freezes in a shallow valley. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#annealing-schedule))_
- **associative memory**: A memory read with part of what was stored, which returns the rest. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#associative-memory))_
- **attention**: Each token takes a weighted sum of the others' values, the weights a softmax of how well its query matches their keys. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#attention))_
- **attractor**: A state the dynamics pull back to from all around it. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#attractor))_
- **backprop**: The chain rule run backwards through a network to get the gradient of the loss for every weight. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#backprop))_
- **basin**: Every starting state that settles into the same attractor. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#basin))_
- **belief propagation**: Decoding by passing messages between bits and checks; the classic LDPC decoder, beside decoding by settling. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#belief-propagation))_
- **bits per byte**: How many bits a model needs, on average, to code each byte of text; lower is better. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#bits-per-byte))_
- **block Gibbs**: Gibbs sampling that re-tosses a whole set of variables with no pulls between them at once, as a checkerboard does on a lattice. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#block-gibbs))_
- **Boltzmann constant**: k = 1.380649 × 10^-23 joules per kelvin, exact since 2019: it turns a temperature into an energy, kT. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#boltzmann-constant))_
- **Boltzmann distribution**: Each arrangement s turns up with probability proportional to e^(-E(s)/T): the distribution settling samples. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#boltzmann-distribution))_
- **Boltzmann machine**: A settling machine that learns: its leans and pulls are fitted so its settles reproduce a set of examples. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#boltzmann-machine))_
- **Brownian motion**: The jitter of a small particle struck at random by the molecules around it. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#brownian-motion))_
- **bundling**: Adding hypervectors bit by bit and keeping the majority: a vector that resembles each one added. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#bundling))_
- **burn-in**: The first sweeps of a settle, thrown away because the machine has not forgotten its random start. _(SETTLE/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#burn-in))_
